categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production, design, sales, and agency of household paper products and cleaning supplies. Household paper accounts for approximately 87% of total sales, cleaning products about 6%, and other items around 7%. It also engages in investment activities through subsidiaries and related companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes core technologies in manufacturing household paper and cleaning products, including advanced papermaking processes such as pulping, refining, paper forming, embossing, folding, cutting, and packaging. It emphasizes R&D in bio-based specialty materials, resource recycling, and eco-friendly packaging. The cleaning products leverage natural formulations, concentrated detergents, and environmentally friendly packaging, supported by multiple certifications like FSC, HACCP, GMP, and ISO standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include end consumers, distributors, chain supermarkets, mass merchandisers, and commercial clients such as hotels and restaurants. The company serves primarily the domestic Taiwanese market with household paper and cleaning products, while also expanding cleaning product sales overseas. Major customers include large retail chains and e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in Taiwan with manufacturing plants in Taiwan and mainland China (Kunshan and Yangzhou). The company also has subsidiaries and investment entities in Hong Kong, the United States, and Samoa, supporting international trade and intellectual property management. The supply chain includes global suppliers from regions such as Northern Europe, North America, South America, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and processing of household paper and cleaning products. Upstream suppliers provide raw materials like pulp, packaging materials, and chemical ingredients. The company manages production, quality control, and distribution to end customers and commercial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainable development with strong ESG integration, innovation in health and environmentally friendly products, and expansion of high-value-added product lines. R&D focuses on natural and functional paper products, concentrated and eco-friendly cleaning formulations, and green packaging solutions. The company plans to increase R&D investment to accelerate new product development and enhance competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of household paper and cleaning supplies. The company also earns income from investments in subsidiaries and related companies. Sales channels include retail, wholesale, and e-commerce platforms, with pricing strategies adjusted for raw material and energy cost fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in Taiwan's household paper and natural cleaning product sectors. Major competitors in household paper include Kimberly-Clark, Cheng Loong, and Goldsun. The company differentiates itself through product innovation, brand strength, and sustainability initiatives, maintaining a competitive edge in a highly competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$10.1 billion in 2022, with a net profit of around NT$689 million, reflecting a decline due to raw material and energy cost increases and COVID-19 impacts in China. Total assets exceed NT$8 billion with stable equity around NT$5.3 billion. The company maintains strong liquidity and solvency ratios, with ongoing capital expenditures for equipment upgrades and sustainability projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, innovative, and sustainable household paper and cleaning products that meet diverse consumer needs. It leverages patented technologies, eco-friendly materials, and certifications to assure product safety and environmental responsibility. The brand portfolio includes trusted names that resonate with health-conscious and environmentally aware consumers, supported by strong R&D and supply chain management.
